lines.text: Forty-one workers are deep inside the Silkyara tunnel when part of it collapses.
Sixty metres of rock now stand between them and the way out.
Behind it: two kilometres of finished tunnel, eight and a half metres high.
The lights still work. And so does one pipe.
Through it come oxygen, puffed rice and dry fruit.
To stay sane, they walk the tunnel and do yoga.
A twenty-five-tonne auger drill is flown in from Delhi by the air force.
The plan: push a steel pipe through the rubble, wide enough to crawl through.
Day nine. A narrow pipe gets through first, and the first hot meal goes in: khichdi, packed in bottles.
The next day, a camera crawls down the same pipe. For the first time, the world sees their faces.

shots.name: mountain
shots.note: Before dawn: tilt down off the snow range, over the forested slope, to the lit mouth.

shots.name: work
shots.note: The night shift: a slow push down a busy bore as the dumper drives in.

shots.name: chai
shots.note: Tea break. Grit patters on his helmet, the lamps dip, he looks up.

shots.name: collapse
shots.note: The crown comes down between the crew and the way out; the dust takes the bore.

shots.name: alive
shots.note: Later. Headlamps in the dust; the power stutters back on the word; forty-one faces.

shots.name: plug_throw
shots.note: Rescue side of the plug: the engineer winds up and flings the tape's hook up into the gap.

shots.name: plug_catch
shots.note: Trapped side: the hook shoots out of the gap, slides down, he catches it on 'Sixty'; 60 m lands.

shots.name: plug_wide
shots.note: Pull out and track along the cutaway: the lit trapped men, 60 m of rubble, the way out.

shots.name: tunnel_space
shots.note: Inside the surviving bore: move through the workers and look up to the ribbed crown.

shots.name: lifeline_lights
shots.note: At the rubble, his headlamp in our eyes; he clicks it off on 'lights' and looks up: the lamps burn all the way down the bore.

shots.name: lifeline_pipe
shots.note: The water main out of the rubble: he spins the gate valve open and water bursts out on 'pipe'.

shots.name: feed_out
shots.note: X-ray of the supply pipe through the rubble: blue oxygen lines race through it, a jar of puffed rice rides the air.

shots.name: feed_in
shots.note: Inside: jars shoot out of the supply line on puffs of air: puffed rice into one man's hands, dry fruit into the other's.

shots.name: laps
shots.note: Days later: pairs and singles walking laps away from us down the lit bore, lamps receding.

shots.name: yoga
shots.note: Yoga on cardboard mats: the leader in front, the group copies; one wobbles and topples.

shots.name: airlift_hold
shots.note: Inside the Hercules: the 25-tonne auger rig chained in the hold; the floor flexes; 25 t lands on 'tonne'.

shots.name: airlift_sky
shots.note: Air to air: the grey IAF Hercules, belly sagging, props a blur, dropping into the valley.

shots.name: airlift_ramp
shots.note: On the airstrip: it rolls to a halt, nose dips, the ramp drops on 'force' and the rig is there.

shots.name: plan_rig
shots.note: The auger rig set up at the rescue face of the rubble, its crew at the controls.

shots.name: rig_push
shots.note: Low along the casing: the rams shove, the spinning auger and the pipe bite into the heap.

shots.name: pipe_crawl
shots.note: From inside a spare 800 mm pipe: a rescuer squeezes in on hands and knees, squashed flat, and grins.

shots.name: day9_tally
shots.note: Day nine: the ninth chalk tally on the lining wall.

shots.name: narrow_pipe
shots.note: A 6-inch pipe noses out of the rubble with a puff of dust; the men lean in.

shots.name: khichdi_cook
shots.note: Outside at night: low across the blue flame ring and the steaming degchi; the cook stirs under the bulb.

shots.name: khichdi_pour
shots.note: Close: a ladle of yellow khichdi slops into the funnel of a plastic bottle.

shots.name: khichdi_bottle
shots.note: Inside, close: the bottle shoots out of the narrow pipe into his hands; he twists the cap off, steam curls up past his face.
